title: SharePoint Server
author: Atlas core
description: Administer site collections on SharePoint Server (Subscription Edition, on-premises) from a process: create a team site, read and list sites, set owners, change site collection administrators and the default groups, delete to the recycle bin, restore, and set the storage quota. A Worker runs fixed PowerShell on a server of the farm as its service account, and no credential reaches Atlas.

properties.label: Worker
properties.description: Name of the configured SharePoint Server Worker (Console → Workers). Its worker runs on a server of the farm.

choices.name: Delete a site to the recycle bin

properties.label: Parameters
properties.description: A JSON object of the operation's parameters; a value starting with = is FEEL. A site is named by its leaf under the managed path, never by a URL.

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Receives what a read, create or restore returned.
